samples.summary: `travelling` exclusion trusts the stale copy buffer's anchors/spans instead of the live merge map
samples.evidence: `const travelling = new Set<Sref>(isCut ? sourceMerges.map((m) => toSref(m.anchor)) : [])` (sheet.ts:2432) is built from `this.copyBuffer.merges`, a snapshot taken at `cut()` time (snapshotMergesIn, sheet.ts:2194). The copy buffer is not invalidated when the merge map changes (only spreadsheet.ts:725 / worksheet.ts:4938,5109 clear it; mergeSelection/unmergeSelection do not). If the user unmerges and re-merges at the same anchor with a LARGER span between cut and paste, the filter at sheet.ts:2435-2437 excludes that anchor from the split check even though the live block now extends outside `destRange`, so the refusal that fired before this delta no longer fires. The cut branch then deletes the whole live block (`this.merges.delete(anchorSref)`, sheet.ts:2479) while adding only the STALE span's covered srefs to `changedSrefs` (sheet.ts:2475 uses `merge.span` from the buffer), leaving cells that stopped aliasing an anchor un-invalidated (stale formula results) — i.e. this delta newly exposes an inconsistent-state path that the previous unconditional check masked. Compare moveRangeTo (sheet.ts:2607-2614), which derives `movedAnchors` from the live map so it cannot go stale.
searchedFor: read applyPasteMerges and moveRangeTo merge handling

finding.summary: `selectPastedRange` switched to `rangeOf`, which spreads one argument per pasted cell into `Math.min`/`Math.max` — a large paste can throw RangeError (stack overflow)
finding.evidence: The removed code walked the grid keys with an explicit loop tracking minR/maxR/minC/maxC. The replacement calls `rangeOf(grid)` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/coordinates.ts:18-27), which does `Math.min(...rows)` / `Math.max(...cols)` with `rows.length === grid.size`. A paste of a large TSV/region (~100k+ non-empty cells, easily reachable for a 10k-row × 10-col external paste) exceeds V8's argument-spread limit and throws `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded`. This happens after `store.endBatch()`, so the data is written but `paste()` rejects, leaving the caller with an unhandled rejection and no selection update. `rangeOf` is used nowhere else in src (grep `rangeOf\(`), so nothing else exercised this on paste-sized inputs.

verdict.reason: Verified in-repo: `rangeOf` (packages/sheets/src/model/core/coordinates.ts:18-27) builds `rows`/`cols` arrays of length `grid.size` and spreads them into `Math.min(...)`/`Math.max(...)`. It is called on the full pasted grid from `selectPastedRange` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:2555), which `paste()` invokes at sheet.ts:2377 — after the try/finally whose `finally` runs `this.store.endBatch()` (sheet.ts:2373), so cell data is already committed when it runs. The grid is unbounded on the external-paste path: `string2grid` (packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/grids.ts:113-126) creates one map entry per parsed TSV cell including empties, and `paste()` (sheet.ts:2214-2302) applies no cell-count limit — in contrast to the import path which explicitly caps at MAX_IMPORT_CELLS = 40_000 (packages/sheets/src/import/csv-importer.ts:155,173). View callers pass raw clipboard text through unbounded (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:4937, packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:724). A ~100k-cell paste therefore spreads ~100k arguments, which exceeds V8's spread/argument limit and throws RangeError, rejecting `paste()` after the write and leaving the selection unupdated. No guard makes this unreachable, and it is a runtime crash/state-inconsistency issue, squarely in the correctness lane. Only the precise engine threshold is uncertain, which is a confidence rather than a refutation matter.
